2_Introduction: A significantly higher JSC of 26.581 mA/cm² is obtained while preserving VOC of 1.1818 V and FF of 81.2011%, resulting in the highest PCE of 25.5079% at reverse scan. The 1.65 mol/L perovskite precursor solution with a chemical formula of Cs0.05MA0.08FA0.87PbI3.0 was prepared. The perovskite solutions were spin-coated at 1000 rpm for 5 s and then at 5500 rpm for 30 s. CB (150 µL) was dropped on the film at 15 s before the end of the spinning. The deposited perovskite films were subsequently annealed on a hotplate at 110 °C for 15 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The triple-cation Cs0.05MA0.08FA0.87PbI3.0 composition, with its optimized A-site alloying, enhances phase stability and the tolerance factor while mitigating halide segregation tendencies, where the 1.65 mol/L precursor concentration and the spin-coating protocol—featuring an initial 1000 rpm spread step followed by a rapid 5500 rpm crystallization stage—promote high nucleation density and uniform precursor distribution. The critical introduction of chlorobenzene antisolvent at 15 seconds prior to the spin cycle's conclusion induces a controlled supersaturation spike, rapidly extracting the host solvent to drive homogeneous nucleation while suppressing the formation of PbI2-rich intermediate phases, a crystallization pathway further perfected by the subsequent 110°C thermal annealing which facilitates complete solvent removal, promotes robust grain growth, and passivates intrinsic defects at grain boundaries, thereby reducing non-radiative recombination centers. This meticulously engineered crystallization dynamics, evidenced by the suppression of parasitic PbI2 phases and the promotion of a dense, pinhole-free morphology with large, well-oriented grains, directly translates to enhanced optoelectronic properties: the minimized defect density and improved charge transport pathways yield a high external quantum efficiency across the visible spectrum, which is corroborated by a reduced Urbach energy and a high radiative efficiency, collectively enabling the exceptional photovoltaic parameters of a VOC of 1.1818 V, a JSC of 26.581 mA/cm², an FF of 81.2011%, and a champion PCE of 25.5079%.
